title: PageRank job slow, containers not starting
description: A PageRank MapReduce job ran for about an hour instead of finishing normally; some of its tasks seemed to never start.

groundTruth.cause: One cluster node (04DN8IQ, 10.86.164.9) went down, so the application master kept retrying to connect to it to launch containers and eventually killed the task attempts assigned to it.
goodNextSteps: Check whether node 04DN8IQ (10.86.164.9) is reachable and its NodeManager is running
Check the ResourceManager's node list for that node's state (LOST or UNHEALTHY)

notes: Loghub Hadoop run with an injected machine-down failure. The strongest evidence is 624 INFO-level 'Retrying connect to server' lines; there is one unrelated ERROR line.
